title: Randy Blythe vows to leave the US if Trump wins election
contentHtml:
Randy Blythe, the vocalist for thrash metal band Lamb of God has vowed to leave the United States if Donald Trump is elected for president. Randy recently participated in an interview with website Metal Insider where he was asked for his opinions on the situation with Donald and he said “I think he's going to burn himself out. I think he's going to say something so overarchingly stupid that people are finally going to be unable to accept what he's saying anymore. But I almost think he's a purposeful clown, a tool.”
He then continued on to say "I don't know if he really wants to be President. He might just be a foil for the Republican party to say, 'We've gotta be tough right now in our international relations policy, but not with this guy,' so they'll get someone who looks more moderate into office. They'll say, 'We still need to be strong, hawkish right now, but no, not Donald Trump.' I mean, it's ludicrous the things that he says. He's making shit up."
It seems like Randy Blythe is strongly against the election of Donald which as of now has 33% of electoral support. Where do you stand, do you believe that Randy will actually leave the country if Donald is elected? I sure do. ​
